name: robot_health
description: Representative offline integration example, not headline eval data. Robot-health flag from real kit event act-A0010 (training mission M001): a successful visual inspection of Heat Exchanger 04 run at 15% battery, the critical threshold. Demonstrates meta.path retry. All numbers computed from amd/system1/data/kit with triage.policy 2026-10-10.1. MCP action/document IDs retained in backend-shaped context; database flag ID is illustrative.

flag.title: Can SPOT keep working at 15% battery?

reasons.detail: Battery 15% is at or below the 15% critical threshold

facts.fact: Battery 15% is at or below the 15% critical threshold, giving robot_health, and at or below the 25% low threshold, giving P2, under policy 2026-10-10.1.
Kit actions at battery <= 25% succeeded 8 of 24 (33%), versus 213 of 246 (87%) above 25%.
Mission M001 started at 82% battery; this step-10 action ran at 15%, a drain of 67 points.
Quality GOOD makes the reading trusted, and VISUAL_SCORE 70.0 is below the VISUAL_SCORE safe band minimum 72.0.
